description: Verifier-first TS reasoning operations exposed to AGL.

operations.name: check_support
operations.description: Check whether a claim has typed verifier support.
examples: can we prove A implies C?

operations.name: explain_rejection
operations.description: Explain why a claim was rejected or not accepted.

operations.name: summarize_session
operations.description: Summarise current bounded TS session state.
examples: what do we know so far?

operations.name: correct_candidate
operations.description: Record a correction as candidate language state.
examples: no, I meant B implies C

operations.name: route_unknown
operations.description: Safe abstention route when no confident operation exists.
